notes: URGENT FIX: after-hours sells could still slip through despite the previous fix (CHA sold after hours on a path none of the earlier patches covered). Instead of chasing the next individual leak, the guard now lives at the single lowest-level point in the whole app that actually sends a sell order to Alpaca - every sell, market or limit, algorithmic or manual, first attempt or retry, passes through this one method with no exception. A sell outside regular hours is rejected right there unless the strategy explicitly allows after-hours trading. Also fixed partial-exit sells silently ignoring the allow_after_hours setting.
